list.title: Han River run starts & after-run food
list.desc: A free starter map made by PinWith for Seoul Flyers runners: Han River and Namsan start points plus food and coffee near Yeouido and Banpo. Members can co-edit and add routes.

items.title: Ichon Hangang Park (이촌한강공원)
items.memo: Bike/run path, toilets and drinking fountains; CU nearby; Ichon Station

items.title: Yeouido Hangang Park (여의도한강공원)
items.memo: Wide riverside paths; Yeouinaru Station (Line 5); bike rentals

items.title: Banpo Hangang Park (반포한강공원)
items.memo: South-bank start by Banpo Bridge; rainbow fountain shows in season

items.title: Ttukseom Hangang Park (뚝섬한강공원)
items.memo: East-side riverside start next to Jayang Station (Line 7)

items.title: Seoul Forest Park (서울숲)
items.memo: Tree-lined loops and lawns; Seoul Forest Station (Suin-Bundang Line)

items.title: National Theater of Korea (Namsan loop start)
items.memo: Common start for the car-free Namsan north/south loop roads

items.title: Starbucks Yeouido Hangang Park
items.memo: Coffee right in the park near the river
items.check: small listing; confirm it is the riverside branch

items.title: The Hyundai Seoul (더현대 서울)
items.memo: Food hall on B1 in Yeouido; opens 10:30

items.title: Sevit Island (세빛섬)
items.memo: Floating islands by Banpo Park with cafes and restaurants; 11:00-21:00

items.title: Sandeulhae Banpo (산들해)
items.memo: Korean set-meal spread with refills; 2-person minimum; break 15:00-17:00
